panels.title: Transaction Processing Rate
panels.description: Rate of transactions entering the processing pipeline. tx.process (NetworkOPs.cpp) fires when a transaction is submitted locally or received from a peer and enters processTransaction(). tx.receive (PeerImp.cpp) fires when a raw transaction message arrives from a peer before deduplication.

targets.expr: sum by (exported_instance) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{exported_instance=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", span_name="tx.process", tx_type=~"$tx_type"}[5m]))

sum by (exported_instance) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{exported_instance=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", span_name="tx.receive", tx_type=~"$tx_type"}[5m]))

panels.title: Transaction Processing Latency by Type
panels.description: Per-transaction-type processing latency (p95 and p50). Filter with $tx_type variable above.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, tx_type, exported_instance) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{exported_instance=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", span_name="tx.process", tx_type=~"$tx_type"}[5m])))

histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, tx_type, exported_instance) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{exported_instance=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", span_name="tx.process", tx_type=~"$tx_type"}[5m])))

panels.title: Transaction Path Distribution
panels.description: Breakdown of transactions by origin path. The local attribute indicates whether the transaction was submitted locally (true) or received from a peer (false). Helps understand the ratio of locally-originated vs relayed transactions.

targets.expr: sum by (local, exported_instance) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{exported_instance=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", local=~"$tx_origin", span_name="tx.process", tx_type=~"$tx_type"}[5m]))

panels.title: Transaction Receive vs Suppressed
panels.description: Total rate of raw transaction messages received from peers (tx.receive span from PeerImp.cpp). This fires before deduplication via the HashRouter, so the difference between tx.receive and tx.process reflects suppressed duplicate transactions.

targets.expr: sum by (suppressed, exported_instance) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{span_name="tx.receive", tx_type=~"$tx_type", exported_instance=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Transaction Processing Duration Heatmap
panels.description: Heatmap showing the distribution of tx.process span durations across histogram buckets over time. Each cell represents the count of transactions that completed within that latency bucket in a 5m window. Reveals whether processing times are consistent or exhibit multi-modal patterns.

targets.expr: sum(increase(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{exported_instance=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", span_name="tx.process", tx_type=~"$tx_type"}[5m])) by (le)

panels.title: Transaction Apply Duration per Ledger
panels.description: p95 and p50 latency of applying the consensus transaction set to a new ledger. The tx.apply span (BuildLedger.cpp) wraps the applyTransactions() function that iterates through the CanonicalTXSet and applies each transaction to the OpenView. Long durations indicate heavy transaction sets or expensive transaction processing.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, exported_instance) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{exported_instance=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", span_name="tx.apply"}[5m])))

histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, exported_instance) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{exported_instance=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", span_name="tx.apply"}[5m])))

panels.title: Peer Transaction Receive Rate
panels.description: Rate of transaction messages received from network peers. Sourced from the tx.receive span (PeerImp.cpp) which fires in the onMessage(TMTransaction) handler. High rates may indicate network-wide transaction volume spikes or peer flooding.

targets.expr: sum by (exported_instance) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{exported_instance=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", span_name="tx.receive", tx_type=~"$tx_type"}[5m]))

panels.title: Transaction Apply Failed Rate
panels.description: Rate of tx.apply spans completing with error status, indicating transaction application failures during ledger building. The span records tx_failed as an attribute. Thresholds: green < 0.1/sec, yellow 0.1-1/sec, red > 1/sec. Some failures are normal (e.g. conflicting offers) but sustained high rates may indicate issues.

targets.expr: sum by (exported_instance) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{exported_instance=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", span_name="tx.apply", status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[5m]))

panels.title: Transaction Rate by Type
panels.description: Transaction processing rate broken down by tx_type (Payment, OfferCreate, AMMDeposit, etc.). Requires tx_type dimension in spanmetrics.

targets.expr: sum by (tx_type) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{exported_instance=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", span_name="tx.process", tx_type=~"$tx_type"}[5m]))

panels.title: Transaction Results by Type
panels.description: Transaction result codes (ter_result) broken down by tx_type. Shows which transaction types fail most often.

targets.expr: sum by (tx_type, ter_result) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{exported_instance=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", span_name="tx.process", tx_type=~"$tx_type", ter_result=~"$ter_result", ter_result!="tesSUCCESS"}[5m]))

panels.title: TxQ Accept Status
panels.description: TxQ accept outcomes: applied (included in ledger), failed (removed), retried (kept for next round).

targets.expr: sum by (txq_status) (increase(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{exported_instance=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", span_name="txq.accept_tx", txq_status=~"$txq_status"}[5m]))

panels.title: Transactor Duration by Type (p95)
panels.description: Per-transactor execution time (tx.transactor span). Shows which transaction types are most expensive to execute.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, tx_type, exported_instance) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{exported_instance=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", span_name="tx.transactor", tx_type=~"$tx_type"}[5m])))

panels.title: TxQ Enqueue Rate by Transaction Type
panels.description: Rate of txq.enqueue spans broken down by transaction type (tx_type). Shows what share of inbound demand is Payment vs OfferCreate vs other transactors, and how the mix shifts as the queue fills. A spam burst of one type is a leading indicator of fee escalation.

targets.expr: sum by (tx_type, exported_instance) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{exported_instance=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", span_name="txq.enqueue"}[5m]))

panels.title: Queue Bypass Ratio (Direct Apply vs Enqueue)
panels.description: Ratio of transactions that applied directly to the open ledger (txq.apply_direct) versus those that had to be queued (txq.enqueue). A falling bypass ratio is the cleanest single signal the network has entered sustained fee escalation.

targets.expr: sum by (exported_instance) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{exported_instance=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", span_name="txq.apply_direct"}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (exported_instance) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{exported_instance=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", span_name="txq.apply_direct"}[5m])) + sum by (exported_instance) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{exported_instance=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", span_name="txq.enqueue"}[5m])), 1)

panels.title: Queue Accept (Drain) Duration per Ledger
panels.description: p95/p50 duration of the txq.accept span, which drains queued transactions into a newly closed ledger. Rising drain time signals queue pressure at ledger close.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, exported_instance) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{exported_instance=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", span_name="txq.accept"}[5m])))

histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, exported_instance) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{exported_instance=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", span_name="txq.accept"}[5m])))

panels.title: Queue Cleanup Rate (Expired Entries)
panels.description: Rate of txq.cleanup spans, which remove expired transactions from the queue each ledger. A rising rate means submitters under-bid the escalating fee and abandoned their transactions — a demand-frustration signal distinct from acceptance throughput.

targets.expr: sum by (exported_instance) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{exported_instance=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", span_name="txq.cleanup"}[5m]))

panels.title: Tx Apply Pipeline Rate by Stage
panels.description: Span rate for each apply-pipeline stage (preflight, preclaim, apply). A drop between stages shows where transactions are filtered out. Requires the stage dimension in spanmetrics.

targets.expr: sum by (stage, exported_instance) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{exported_instance=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", span_name=~"tx.preflight|tx.preclaim|tx.transactor", stage=~"$stage"}[5m]))

panels.title: Tx Apply Pipeline Latency by Stage (p95)
panels.description: 95th-percentile duration of each apply-pipeline stage. Isolates which stage (preflight, preclaim, apply) dominates transaction processing time.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, stage, exported_instance) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{exported_instance=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", span_name=~"tx.preflight|tx.preclaim|tx.transactor", stage=~"$stage"}[5m])))

panels.title: Tx Apply Pipeline Failure Rate by Stage
panels.description: Rate of apply-pipeline spans whose ter_result is not tesSUCCESS, split by stage. Shows whether failures concentrate in preflight, preclaim, or apply. Filters on ter_result rather than span status because a failing ter code completes the span normally; only thrown exceptions set an error status.

targets.expr: sum by (stage, exported_instance) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{exported_instance=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", span_name=~"tx.preflight|tx.preclaim|tx.transactor", stage=~"$stage", ter_result!~"tesSUCCESS|"}[5m]))

panels.title: Tx Apply Pipeline Latency by Type and Stage (p95)
panels.description: 95th-percentile duration broken down by both transaction type and apply-pipeline stage. Shows, for each transaction type, which stage (preflight, preclaim, apply) dominates its latency. Higher cardinality than the by-stage view; filter with the $tx_type and $stage variables.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, tx_type, stage, exported_instance) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{exported_instance=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", span_name=~"tx.preflight|tx.preclaim|tx.transactor", tx_type=~"$tx_type", stage=~"$stage"}[5m])))

list.name: node
list.label: Node
list.description: Filter by rippled node (service.instance.id — e.g. Node-1)

list.name: tx_origin
list.label: TX Origin
list.description: Filter by transaction origin (true = local submit, false = peer relay)
